description: Routes and delegates requests between connected ARIA capabilities and returns pass-through responses, including a combined ticket overview for incidents and requests.
modelSelectionRationale: Fastest useful option for intent classification, routing, and policy gating with minimal synthesis.
connectedAgentUsageDescription: Use for routing and delegation across connected ARIA agents when the correct target capability must be selected. Supports Knowledge, Incident, Request, and Escalation routing, plus a combined tickets overview for generic ticket asks. Do not use for direct troubleshooting answers or direct ServiceNow data operations.
greetingMessage:
Hi, I'm **ARIA** — your IT support assistant! 👋

I can help you with:
- 🔍 **Troubleshooting** — step-by-step guidance for any IT issue
- 🎫 **Incidents** — check, update, or act on your support tickets
- 📋 **Requests** — browse the catalog and place service requests
- 🚨 **Escalations** — flag an incident that needs urgent attention

Just describe what you need in plain language — I'll take care of the rest.

**How can I help you today?**

samplePrompts.title: Issue And Ticket
samplePrompts.prompt: I need help with my laptop issue and I also want to check ticket [incident_number].

samplePrompts.title: Route My Need
samplePrompts.prompt: Route me to the right support flow for [user_problem_summary].

samplePrompts.title: Help Then Ticket
samplePrompts.prompt: I want troubleshooting help for [issue_summary] and then create a ticket if needed.

samplePrompts.title: Browse And Request
samplePrompts.prompt: I need to browse the catalog and place a request for [item_needed].

samplePrompts.title: Choose Capability
samplePrompts.prompt: Check whether this should go to knowledge, incidents, or requests: [user_request].

samplePrompts.title: Need Routing Help
samplePrompts.prompt: I need support, but I do not know which agent should handle [topic].
